text_en: The Lord said to Moses:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Consecrate to me all the firstborn; whatever is the first to open the womb among the Israelites, of human beings and animals, is mine.
text_cn: “以色列子民中，无论是人是牲畜，凡是开胎首生的，都应祝圣于我，属于我。”

text_en: Moses said to the people, “Remember this day on which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, because the Lord brought you out from there by strength of hand; no leavened bread shall be eaten.
text_cn: 梅瑟向百姓说：“你们应当记念从埃及，从为奴之家出来的这一天，因为上主在这一天用强有力的手臂，从那里领出了你们，故此不可吃有酵的食物。

text_en: Today, in the month of Abib, you are going out.
text_cn: 今天你们出来正在"阿彼布"月。

text_en: When the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he swore to your ancestors to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, you shall keep this observance in this month.
text_cn: 几时上主领你们进了客纳罕人、赫特人、阿摩黎人、希威人和耶步斯人的地方，就是他向你的祖先起誓应许给你那流奶流蜜之地，你应在这一月举行此礼：

text_en: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a festival to the Lord .
text_cn: 七天之内应吃无酵饼，第七天是敬礼上主的节日。

text_en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days; no leavened bread shall be seen in your possession, and no leaven shall be seen among you in all your territory.
text_cn: 七天之内吃无酵饼，在你面前不可有发酵之物，在你四境之内也不可见有酵母。

text_en: You shall tell your child on that day, ‘It is because of what the Lord did for me when I came out of Egypt. ’
text_cn: 在那一天要告诉你们的儿子说：是因为上主在我出埃及时，为我所行的事。

text_en: It shall serve for you as a sign on your hand and as a reminder on your forehead, so that the teaching of the Lord may be on your lips; for with a strong hand the Lord brought you out of Egypt.
text_cn: 应把这事做你手上的记号，做你额上的记念，好使上主的法律常在你口中，因为上主用强有力的手臂，领你出了埃及。

text_en: You shall keep this ordinance at its proper time from year to year.
text_cn: 所以你应年年按照定期遵守这规定。

text_en: “When the Lord has brought you into the land of the Canaanites, as he swore to you and your ancestors, and has given it to you,
text_cn: 当上主照他起誓向你和你祖先所许的话，领你到了客纳罕人的地方，将那地给了你之后，

text_en: you shall set apart to the Lord all that first opens the womb. All the firstborn of your livestock that are males shall be the Lord ’s.
text_cn: 你应将一切开胎首生者归于上主；你牲畜中，凡开胎首生的牲畜，亦应归于上主。

text_en: But every firstborn donkey you shall redeem with a sheep; if you do not redeem it, you must break its neck. Every firstborn male among your children you shall redeem.
text_cn: 凡首生的驴，应用羊赎回；你若不赎回，应打断它的颈项。你的子孙中，凡是长子，你应赎回。

text_en: When in the future your child asks you, ‘What does this mean? ’ you shall answer, ‘By strength of hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
text_cn: 将来若你的儿子问你：这是什么意思？你要回答他说：这是因为上主用强有力的手臂领我们出离了埃及，出离了为奴之家。

text_en: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the Lord killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from human firstborn to the firstborn of animals. Therefore I sacrifice to the Lord every male that first opens the womb, but every firstborn of my sons I redeem. ’
text_cn: 原来法郎顽固，不释放我们，上主就把埃及国一切首生者，不拘是人或牲畜的首生者都杀了，为此我把一切首开母胎的雄性都祭献于上主；但首生的男孩，我却要赎回。

text_en: It shall serve as a sign on your hand and as an emblem on your forehead that by strength of hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt. ”
text_cn: 应将这事作你手上的记号，作你额上的标志，记念上主用强有力的手臂领我们出了埃及。”

text_en: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them by way of the land of the Philistines, although that was nearer; for God thought, “If the people face war, they may change their minds and return to Egypt. ”
text_cn: 法郎放走百姓以后，天主没有领他们走培肋舍特地的近路，因为天主想：“怕百姓遇见战争而后悔，再回到埃及。”

text_en: So God led the people by the roundabout way of the wilderness toward the Red Sea. The Israelites went up out of the land of Egypt prepared for battle.
text_cn: 因此天主领百姓绕道，走向靠红海的旷野。以色列子民都武装着离开了埃及。

text_en: And Moses took with him the bones of Joseph who had required a solemn oath of the Israelites, saying, “God will surely take notice of you, and then you must carry my bones with you from here. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟也带了若瑟的骨骸，因为若瑟曾叫以色列的儿子们起誓说：“天主必要眷顾你们，那时你们应把我的骨骸从此地带回去。”

text_en: They set out from Succoth, and camped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.
text_cn: 他们从稣苛特起程前行，就在位于旷野边缘的厄堂安了营。

text_en: The Lord went in front of them in a pillar of cloud by day, to lead them along the way, and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light, so that they might travel by day and by night.
text_cn: 上主在他们前面行，白天在云柱里给他们领路，夜间在火柱里光照他们，为叫他们白天黑夜都能走路：

text_en: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place in front of the people.
text_cn: 白天的云柱，黑夜的火柱，总不离开百姓面前。
